filtered_30km_500m.rule: Keep only customers with OSRM depot->point < 30000 m and point->depot < 30000 m; final selected points satisfy directed OSRM pair distance >= 500 m.

meta.selection_rule: Use real points inside 10 mile square from 1000.1 first, add unique real points from 1000.2, then add real OSM POIs from Overpass.

theta_one_replacement.rule: For theta_ijl == 1.00, sample Uniform(min_l,max_l) from empirical l-specific theta values excluding 1.00, rounded to 2 decimals.
